groups.rationale: The two rows state the same Links-Quivers correspondence for every link; the transformed HOMFLY-PT/quiver-series and motivic-series formulations differ only by normalization and notation.
All three bodies state the identical Burning Number Conjecture b(G) <= ceil(sqrt(n)) for every connected n-vertex graph.
Equivalent complex and l-adic coefficient formulations of the same local spectral-support containment; review evidence explicitly links both through equivalent row 1474.
For the stated smooth 4-manifold, Property (S) is the paper's equivalent formulation of nontriviality of the boundary Dehn twist after deleting a small ball.
Both state Taut-20: for every g,n, even cohomology H^k(Mbar_{g,n}) is tautological through degree 20.
Identical strong Lefschetz conjecture for the Hartshorne-Rao module of a general union of r lines in projective 3-space.
Equivalent KLT-singularity F-signature and projective log-Fano Frobenius-alpha formulations under the dimension-shift correspondence stated in the source.
Identical naive atomic blowup formula with the same smooth-center, codimension, and N_1-embedding hypothesis.
Identical Ng conjecture: under RH and simple zeros, sum |zeta(2rho)/zeta'(rho)|^2 through height T is asymptotic to T/(2*pi).
Identical Gonek conjecture: under RH and simple zeros, sum 1/|zeta'(rho)|^2 through height T is asymptotic to 3T/pi^3.
The signed primitive quadratic-form positivity and GL_n(O)-component positive-eigenvalue statements are equivalent formulations of the same Hodge-Riemann conjecture in the source.
Both bodies state exactly W(rhobar) = W^cris(rhobar) = W^explicit(rhobar) for every semisimple mod-p representation.
The same Andrade-Keating Ratios Conjecture for the hyperelliptic function-field family, written in signed-shift versus subset notation.
Identical Manickam-Miklos-Singhi conjecture: the count bound binom(n-1,k-1) is the probability bound k/n after division by binom(n,k).
Exact Hadamard conjecture: a Hadamard matrix exists in every order divisible by four.
Exact Babai-Seress conjecture: every finite nonabelian simple group has worst-case Cayley diameter bounded by a power of log |G|.
Exact Zhi-Wei Sun A308734 conjecture: every integer n>1 is a sum of two arbitrary squares, a square of a 2-3-smooth number, and a square of a 2-5-smooth number.

Exact abc quality formulation: for every epsilon>0, only finitely many coprime a+b=c triples have quality greater than 1+epsilon. Parent variants ATV-00005065 and ATV-00005066 are standard equivalent formulations, but ATV-00005067 is the exact textual match.
Exact Dickson conjecture for every admissible finite family of positive-slope integer linear forms to be simultaneously prime infinitely often.
The vanishing of every even character eigenspace A_p(omega^(2k)) is the standard class-group eigenspace formulation of the Kummer-Vandiver conjecture in the parent.
Exact Agoh formulation of Agoh-Giuga: p>1 is an odd prime iff p*B_(p-1) is congruent to -1 modulo p.

notes: Missing category/context flags are metadata and publication-quality warnings; viable_unique_count subtracts semantic duplicates only.
The audit deliberately does not collapse related, implied, restricted, generalized, stronger, or weaker statements.

Examples retained as distinct include candidate 2128 versus parent cuboid irreducibility conjectures, RH-dependent moment conjectures versus RH, bilinear Heisenberg Kakeya versus Euclidean Kakeya, and near-alpha valuations versus graceful labeling.
All 889 canonical review rows joined their source row by exact id and content_hash; merged A/B reviews were used once, not double-counted with fragments.
